pairs: Deponentes igitur omnem malitiam, et omnem dolum,
Therefore, set aside all malice and all deceitfulness,
et simulationes, et invidias, et omnes detractiones,
as well as falseness and envy and every detraction.
desire the milk of reasonableness without guile,
ut in eo crescatis in salutem:
so that by this you may increase unto salvation,
si tamen gustastis quoniam dulcis est Dominus.
if it is true that you have tasted that the Lord is sweet.
And approaching him as if he were a living stone,
but elect and honored by God,
et ipsi tamquam lapides vivi superædificamini,
be also yourselves like living stones, built upon him,
a holy priesthood, so as to offer up spiritual sacrifices,
acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
Ecce pono in Sion lapidem summum angularem,
I am setting in Zion a chief cornerstone, elect,
pretiosum: et qui crediderit in eum, non confundetur.
And whoever will have believed in him will not be confounded.”
Therefore, to you who believe, he is honor.
But to those who do not believe,
the stone which the builders have rejected,
hic factus est in caput anguli,
the same has been made into the head of the corner,
to those who are offended by the Word;
though they also have been built upon him.
But you are a chosen generation,
ut virtutes annuntietis ejus qui de tenebris vos vocavit in admirabile lumen suum.
so that you may announce the virtues of him who has called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
Though in past times you were not a people,
yet now you are the people of God.
Though you had not obtained mercy,
yet now you have obtained mercy.
obsecro vos tamquam advenas et peregrinos abstinere vos a carnalibus desideriis,
I beg you, as new arrivals and sojourners, to abstain from carnal desires,
conversationem vestram inter gentes habentes bonam:
Keep your behavior among the Gentiles to what is good,
ut in eo quod detrectant de vobis tamquam de malefactoribus,
so that, when they slander you as if you were evildoers, they may,
by the good works that are seen in you,
glorify God on the day of visitation.
Subjecti igitur estote omni humanæ creaturæ propter Deum:
Therefore, be subject to every human creature because of God,
whether it is to the king as preeminent,
sive ducibus tamquam ab eo missis ad vindictam malefactorum,
or to leaders as having been sent from him for vindication over evildoers,
it is truly for the praise of what is good.
For such is the will of God,
ut benefacientes obmutescere faciatis imprudentium hominum ignorantiam:
that by doing good you may bring about the silence of imprudent and ignorant men,
et non quasi velamen habentes malitiæ libertatem,
and not as if cloaking malice with liberty,
subditi estote in omni timore dominis,
be subject to your masters with all fear,
not only to the good and meek,
si propter Dei conscientiam sustinet quis tristitias,
when, because of God, a man willingly endures sorrows,
if you sin and then suffer a beating?
sed si bene facientes patienter sustinetis,
But if you do well and suffer patiently,
For you have been called to this because Christ also suffered for us,
quia et Christus passus est pro nobis,
vobis relinquens exemplum ut sequamini vestigia ejus:
so that you would follow in his footsteps.
nec inventus est dolus in ore ejus:
neither was deceit found in his mouth.
And when evil was spoken against him,
Then he handed himself over to him who judged him unjustly.
qui peccata nostra ipse pertulit in corpore suo super lignum;
He himself bore our sins in his body upon the tree, so that we,
By his wounds, you have been healed.
For you were like wandering sheep.
sed conversi estis nunc ad pastorem,
But now you have been turned back toward the Pastor
and the Bishop of your souls.
